item.title: Execute Order 99!
item.description: Tough times in the Imperial Legions. In an effort to foster a more “friendly” public image, the Emperor has us out selling tasty frozen snacks. So until Tatooine freezes over, you can call me the Storm Scooper!

item.title: In a world of minor disappointment
item.description: The “fully immersive Willy Wonka Experience” I’m visiting today turned out to be a bit less impressive than I’d anticipated. Still, at least I got this beer out of it!

item.title: Come to the pub! We’ll get together! Have some laughs!
item.description: Looks like Christmas has come early this year, so grab yourself a can and come on in… Welcome to the party, pal!

item.title: The last pub not corrupted by capitalism!
item.description: Today we revisit a Drinktober Comics classic issue. After drinking a can of Nova IPA, Beerman becomes imbued with the awesome power of the Nova Force and sets off to celebrate on a galactic pub crawl.

item.title: Drinky Drinky Beer
item.description: The dwarven bards don’t mention this in their songs but it’s thirsty work Diggin’ a Hole. Lucky for me I’ve got a tasty beer waiting for me when I’m done.

item.title: I came in like a Shrekking Ball
item.description: Day two of Drinktober and I’m getting absolutely Shrekked on this Staggeringly Good Shreker Wrecker

item.title: Welcome to the Beak Parade!
item.description: When I was A young bird My father Flew me down to the seaside To steal somebody’s chips Alright folks, we are back! Drinktober 2026 begins in style as we join the Beak Parade!

item.title: Beer I go again on my own!
item.description: Ancient spirits of alcohol. Transform this decayed form… into Beerman! The Ever Drinking! So it’s been a while and there’ve been a few changes around these parts while we were away. First of all, shortly after the thrilling conclusion of Drinktober 2024 that absolute rotter Heidi decided to stop drinking for good. Shocking, right? What kind of a monster puts her own health and wellbeing ahead of my narcissistic need for attention?
